phase_name: Live 3-task parity run and full gate set

objectives.description: Capture a pre-change baseline decision set for a real 3-task candidate
Run orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh --dry-run over the same 3-task set/state.json
Compare dispatch rows task-by-task against baseline

deviations.description: Every scripts/lint/*.sh exits 0; verify-deploy.sh exits 0 before and after deploy

See the phase's Reasoned Exclusions record for evidence.
